title: Chinese Anti-Japanese War Equipment
description: Adds 1937 German-equipped Adjusted Division uniforms and a Dadao to commemorate the July 7th Incident. For Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge.
body:
Remember history, never forget the national humiliation.

This is a decorative uniform expansion mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge, created in commemoration of the "July 7th Incident" (Marco Polo Bridge Incident) and the outbreak of the Battle of Songhu. Version 1.0 recreates the classic uniforms of the main force of the National Revolutionary Army in 1937 – the "German-equipped Adjusted Divisions."

Current Version (July 7) includes:

· 5 Uniform Sets: Squad Leader, Rifleman, Machine Gunner, Medic, and Signaler. (This is the author's first mod; models and textures may not be very refined yet, but will be improved in future updates.)
· Melee weapon – "Dadao" (Great Sword): Deals 25 attack damage with an attack speed of only 0.8 – slow but devastating, one slash, one kill.

Best Match (Gunpack Addon – Work in Progress):
To complete the firepower, I am developing an addon for the "Timeless & Zero" gun mod. Upon completion, it will include the following 7 classic firearms:

· Hanyang 88 Rifle | Type 24 (Zhongzheng) Rifle | ZB-26 Light Machine Gun
· Qingdao-made MP18 Submachine Gun | SIG M1920 Submachine Gun (iconic to the Guangxi Clique – the SIG may be delayed as it is not directly related to the current German-equipped divisions)
· Mauser C96 "Broomhandle" Pistol & C96 Rapid-Fire Variant

(Note: The current beta of the addon only includes the Type 24 and the ZB-26. The full set is expected to be released around September or October. It is highly recommended to use both mods together. In later update milestones, more firearms will be added alongside the uniform updates, including Soviet-style weapons like the Mosin-Nagant for future Soviet-equipped units.)

Future Roadmap:

· September 18 (Mukden Incident): Adding uniforms of the Northeastern Army – paying tribute to the anti-Japanese pioneers in the northeast.
· December 13 (End of the Nanjing Defense): Adding uniforms of the elite Central Training Corps – the most sophisticated German-modeled unit at the time.
· Future Plans: Uniforms of regional forces such as the Sichuan Army, Guangxi Army, Yunnan Army, as well as later Central Army elite units equipped with Soviet and American gear, are all on the roadmap. Stay tuned!

May the mountains and rivers remain intact, and the heroes be immortal.

铭记历史，勿忘国耻。

本模组是为纪念“七七事变”暨淞沪会战爆发而制作的《我的世界》1.20.1 Forge 制服扩展包。当前版本（1.0）还原了1937年淞沪战场中，国民革命军主力——“德械调整师”的经典制服。

当前版本（7月7日）包含：

· 5套制服：步兵班长、步枪手、机枪手、医疗兵、通信兵。（这是作者的第1个模组，建模和贴图等可能不是很精致，日后还会进行精细化）
· 近战利器“大刀”：攻击伤害 25点，攻速仅 0.8，一刀制敌。

最佳搭配（枪械扩展包 · 开发中）：
为还原完整火力，我正在制作「永恒枪械工坊：零」的附属包，预计完工后包含以下 7把经典枪械：

· 汉阳造88式步枪 | 中正式步枪 (24式) | ZB-26轻机枪
· 青岛造MP18冲锋枪 | SIG M1920冲锋枪（桂军标志性装备，SIG冲锋枪可能会延后发布，因为与目前的德械师无关）
· 毛瑟C96“盒子炮” 及 C96速射型
  （注：当前附属包内测中仅含中正式与ZB-26，完整版预计在9月份或10月份发布，建议两者搭配使用，并且在后期的几个更新节点中还会同步跟进枪械，甚至还会加入莫辛纳甘等苏械师的武器）

未来更新路线图：

· 9月18日（九一八事变）：新增东北军制服系列，致敬白山黑水间的抗战先驱。
· 12月13日（南京保卫战结束）：新增中央教导总队制服——当时最精锐的德式样板部队。
· 未来展望：川军、桂军、滇军等地方部队以及苏械和美械等后期中央军精锐部队制服已在计划中，敬请期待。

愿山河无恙，英雄不朽。
